reason: We do the zoo, the library and church groups, and they're free. I'd still be chasing my kid around, so I wouldn't actually get to sit and drink coffee. I don't pay for kid activities and I can't see a monthly fee sticking.
objection: I'd be paying $59 a month to chase my toddler around an indoor room when the zoo and park cost nothing. The coffee part doesn't really happen with a little one.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial day or a free first visit, plus a rainy-day pass that is only a few dollars. Even then I'd probably only go on bad-weather days.
